label: 3 November 2026
title: Flick targets top eight as Barça host Aston Villa
deck: Hansi Flick says the side must prove itself against Unai Emery’s side. None of the six injured players return for tonight. Cubarsí, Pedri, Rodri and Yamal nominated for FIFPRO World XI.

stories.headline: Flick: we must show our best football against Aston Villa
stories.summary: Hansi Flick said Barcelona have the quality to win La Liga and the Champions League ahead of tonight’s meeting with Aston Villa at Spotify Camp Nou. Kick-off is 21:00 CET.
stories.body: In Monday’s press conference the German described Unai Emery as one of the best coaches in Europe and the world. He said Villa are a fantastic team with a clear structure in defence and attack and different patterns of play. Nicolas Jackson is at an unbelievable level, he added. Barça sit eighth in the league phase after three games. They beat Feyenoord and Galatasaray before losing to Paris Saint-Germain. Flick said nothing has changed about the aim of finishing in the top eight after the two recent defeats. He noted the side had won 11 games in a row before those setbacks.

tweets.text: Hansi Flick: "We have to show our best football. We have enough quality to achieve our goals: winning La Liga and the Champions League."

tweets.name: FC Barcelona
tweets.text: Flick: "Debemos mostrar nuestro mejor fútbol. Tenemos suficiente calidad para alcanzar nuestros objetivos: ganar la Liga y la Champions"

stories.headline: None of the six injured players available for Villa
stories.summary: Hansi Flick confirmed Christensen, Eric García, Koundé, Dani Olmo and Xavi Espart will miss tonight. Roony Bardghji remains long-term. Most are aimed at a return after the international break.
stories.body: Flick said it is not easy to manage four quality defenders being out. He expects Eric García, Koundé, Christensen and Olmo to be available after the next international window. For Espart, who has a syndesmosis issue in his right ankle, the timeline is longer. Flick said he might see him in the first match of next year. Christensen completed part of Sunday’s session as a neutral player but stayed in the gym on Monday. Frenkie de Jong and Brian Fariñas have filled in at the back. Barça host Aston Villa without any of the six returning to the squad.

stories.headline: Flick: Raphinha is playing at an exceptional level
stories.summary: Hansi Flick praised Raphinha as the team’s captain and said he is always focused on and off the ball. The Brazilian is in excellent form after his double against Alavés.
stories.body: The German told reporters he is very happy with Raphinha’s work and performances. He described him as a leader who sets an example for teammates. Raphinha scored twice in the 6-1 win over Alavés and has 15 league goals in 11 matches. He also has three assists this season. Flick said the side has enough quality to achieve its objectives. He singled out the Brazilian ahead of the Champions League fixture.

tweets.name: FC Barcelona
tweets.text: Hansi Flick: "Raphinha is playing at an exceptional level. He's always focused, both on and off the ball. He's our captain, and I'm very happy with his work and performances."

stories.headline: Cubarsí, Pedri, Rodri and Yamal shortlisted for FIFPRO World XI
stories.summary: Pau Cubarsí, Pedri, Rodri and Lamine Yamal are among the 26 candidates for the men’s FIFPRO World XI. The final team is due on 9 November.
stories.body: The shortlist was released after a vote of almost 20,000 professional players from 75 countries. Cubarsí is nominated among the defenders. Pedri and Rodri appear in midfield. Yamal is among the attackers alongside Harry Kane, Lionel Messi, Kylian Mbappé and Cristiano Ronaldo. Raphinha is not on the list. The club noted that several women’s players from the side are also shortlisted, including Cata Coll. The men’s World XI will be announced on 9 November.

tweets.text: 🏆 Cubarsí, Rodrigo, Pedri and Lamine Yamal, candidates for FIFPRO World XI

stories.headline: Squad completes final session ahead of Villa
stories.summary: All available first-team players trained on Monday under Hansi Flick. Five Barça Atlètic players also took part as preparations finished for the 21:00 kick-off.
stories.body: The club said the group finalised work for the Champions League match. Hamza Abdelkarim, Orian Goren, Guillem Víctor, Iker Rodríguez and Àlex Campos joined the session. Anthony Gordon spoke to the media alongside Flick. The first-team starters from the Alavés win had done recovery work on Sunday. Kick-off against Aston Villa is 21:00 at Spotify Camp Nou. The side is targeting a return to winning ways in Europe after the defeat in Paris.

stories.headline: Flick trying to help Balde regain confidence
stories.summary: Hansi Flick said he has spoken to Alejandro Balde and is working to help the left-back recover confidence after limited minutes.
stories.body: The coach told reporters it is normal to lose confidence when not playing regularly. He said Balde is doing very well in every training session and remains a good option. Balde is still young, came through La Masia and this is his club, Flick added. He described him as a great lad and a fantastic player. Gerard Martín can also operate at left-back or centre-back. Balde started on the bench against Alavés.

tweets.name: Mundo Deportivo
tweets.text: Flick: "Hablé con Balde e intento ayudarle a recuperar la confianza"

stories.headline: Fariñas an option again; good connection with Yamal
stories.summary: Hansi Flick said Brian Fariñas deserves to play after his debut at right-back against Alavés. He noted the youngster has a good connection with Lamine Yamal.
stories.body: Fariñas started at right-back on Saturday with Koundé, Eric García and Espart unavailable. Flick said the pair are friends and did very well together. He will assess how Fariñas looks on Tuesday and noted another player could also come in. Gerard Martín is in the plans at left-back. The coach has used midfielders and younger players to cover the defensive absences. No official lineup has been announced.

stories.headline: Five matches in November around the international break
stories.summary: Barça face Aston Villa tonight, Atlético Madrid on 8 November, then Villarreal, Sabah and Deportivo after the break.
stories.body: The Champions League fixture against Unai Emery’s side is the first of five in the month. Atlético visit the Metropolitano on Sunday 8 November at 21:00. The international break runs from 9 to 17 November. Barça host Villarreal on 22 November at 14:00. They travel to Sabah on 25 November at 18:45 in the Champions League. The final November fixture is away to Deportivo on 28 or 29 November. Several players will leave for Nations League or friendlies during the window.

stories.headline: Caroline Graham Hansen named MVP at Mundo Deportivo gala
stories.summary: The Norwegian received the CaixaBank MVP Trophy at the VI European Women’s Football Gala. She singled out the Bilbao Champions League final as her top experience.
stories.body: Graham Hansen said she is in a team with the best in the world and thanked Mundo Deportivo for supporting women’s football. She scored 15 goals and provided 15 assists in the title-winning 2025/26 season. She recalled the Bilbao final with more than 50,000 culés as the standout. Marta Torrejón also received the Excellence Trophy. The event took place on Monday. Graham Hansen finished sixth in the last Ballon d’Or voting.
